text:
Maya Chen: Ok folks — starting thread on sidepanel grouping + URL sync. Goal: make deep links shareable & predictable when groups are collapsed. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx (proto)

Alex Rivera: I pushed a prototype. Highlights: collapsible groups with per-group route. Example routes below. Needs routing discussion.

Sam O'Neill: Question: if group is collapsed and you deep link to an item in that group, should the UI auto-expand that group or open item in a global view?

Pat Gomez: I vote auto-expand. deep links should land you in the same visual context. If we don't expand, users might not realize item is inside group.

Lisa Tran: Accessibility nit: if we auto-expand, ensure focus moves to the item and aria-expanded updates. Also need a skip link to the main content.

Alex Rivera: Proposed route schema:
```
/apps/:appId/overview
/apps/:appId/side/:groupId?/item/:itemId
```
Note groupId optional so legacy links still resolve. Router normalizes to include groupId when known.

Maya Chen: Note: hash routing causes weird back button behavior in embedded widgets. Prefer history API with canonical URLs + redirection logic for old hashes.

Sam O'Neill: Also add focus-restoration for back/forward navigation. We should write accessibility tests that assert focus landing.

Pat Gomez: Analytics: track nav_deeplink_open and nav_group_auto_expanded booleans so we can measure surprises.

Alex Rivera: Edge case: user has local collapse state different from deep link. Suggest resolution order: 1) apply deep link (expand target group), 2) update local collapse state, 3) write state to sessionStorage for ephemeral preferences.

Lisa Tran: Copy tweak: consider renaming 'Dashboard' -> 'Overview' to reduce ambiguity with per-team dashboards.

Maya Chen: Implementation plan:
- Alex: router + normalization (canary) — due Wed
- Alex: add route fallback for hash -> history
- Sam: accessibility test harness + docs
- Maya: update Figma + microcopy
- Pat: hook analytics

Alex Rivera: Quick code pattern for normalization:
```
const normalizeRoute = (route) => {
  // if item present and no group, look up group for item then push new URL
  if (route.matches('/apps/:appId/side/:itemId') && !route.params.groupId) {
    const group = lookupGroupForItem(route.params.itemId)
    history.replace(`/apps/${route.params.appId}/side/${group}/item/${route.params.itemId}`)
  }
}
```

Sam O'Neill: Small keyboard nav ask: left/right arrow to expand/collapse groups? need to check WAI-ARIA tree patterns. :thinking_face:

Maya Chen: Agree. Let's follow ARIA tree role and use Enter/Space to toggle + Arrow keys for traversal. Add to task list.

Alex Rivera: I'll open a PR with router changes and test plan.

Pat Gomez: +1 — will add analytics events.

Lisa Tran: +1 on copy change. Will make microcopy suggestions in Figma.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. We'll review in next design sync. :raised_hands:
